reason: B is the better proposal because partial recrystallization and grain-scale heterogeneity from rolling plus annealing are more physically plausible routes to a strength–ductility synergy while preserving the alloy chemistry responsible for energetic release. It remains weakened by the unsupported assumption that a MoNbTaW-type alloy has a relevant “subtransus” or will form ductile precipitates, and by failing to quantify acceptable strength and energy-release retention.
